messages:
olivia: Heads-up — enterprise customer Aurelia Health opened an urgent ticket (INC-12345). Since ~03:20 UTC they see spikes of 5xx (mostly 503/504) from our hosted inference gateway. They pasted a curl trace showing TLS handshake timeouts. They claim it correlates with a cert rotation we rolled earlier this morning in eu-west-1.

kevin: Thanks, olivia. Any customer headers/request IDs? need to hunt traces.

olivia: They included one request id: req_0z7bQX. Sample curl: `curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <tok>"` output shows: `* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)` then long pause, then `* Connect phase timed out` and `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable` from our gateway.

ashley: @kevin I also saw alerts from gateway-pool-eu-west that envoys reported `upstream connect error or disconnect` spikes at 03:18-03:25. Might be resolver flapping.

infra-bot: Deploy event: cert-rotation-eu-west rolled at 03:05 UTC to 03:12 UTC. 5/6 hosts rotated successfully, host-05 reported `certificate_reload_error` then recovered at 03:14.

diego: Repro idea: request via curl with `-v` to see SNI and handshake timings, and from an external vantage (eg fastly / third party) to check if it's selective. Also run `dig +trace` for the customer's domain and our gateway frontends to verify TTL and resolver differences.

onora: Checked tracing: req_0z7bQX passed through edge-gw-03 then failed handoff to inference-router-1 with `TLS handshake timeout`. No application logs for model worker — implies failure before proxied connection established.

kevin: Could be intermittent resolver returning stale A records during cert rollback. We recently decreased DNS TTL during rotation but maybe some caches saw partial state. Any evidence of SERVFAIL / TRUNCATION?

ashley: Customer provided their `dig` output: `;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 12345` and an A record pointing to 10.11.12.13 (expected). But I also see their dig shows an extra CNAME chain in our CDN provider intermittently. Suspect CDN DNS propagation + cert overlap.

diego: Let's do immediate mitigations: 1) pin traffic for critical customers to control plane region (can we move Aurelia to eu-central fallback?) 2) increase envoy `tls_handshake_timeout` from 5s to 10s temporarily 3) roll host-05 out of rotation until we verify certs.

olivia: Customer asked for a mitigation ASAP, they are seeing failures for their clinical workflows. They want status and a workaround.

kevin: I'll open an active incident and run `tcpdump -nni any port 443 and host 10.11.12.13` on edge-gw-03 to capture the failed handshakes, and fetch `openssl s_client -connect 10.11.12.13:443 -servername api.redwood.example -showcerts` output.

nora: Also capture resolver logs from coredns on nodes serving those edges (`kubectl logs -l app=coredns -n infra`) — look for SERVFAIL or upstream timeouts to provider resolvers.

support-bot: Customer impact note: INC-12345 flagged P1. Notifying support escalation list and account exec.

ashley: Quick config change to envoys applied to eu-west pool: increased `tls_handshake_timeout` to 12s and added a 3-attempt retry on connect-level failures. Monitor now.

infra-bot: Routing change: host-05 removed from active pool at 03:30 UTC. Traffic shifted to host-01..04.

kevin: Captures show a pattern: client SYN -> our TLS ClientHello forwarded to upstream, upstream replied with ServerHello but our gateway sometimes dropped during cert chain validation when OCSP stapling response was delayed from CA (2-3s). That combined with resolver jitter caused handshake timeouts in the 5-12s window.

olivia: Summarize for customer: we are investigating a partial DNS/OCSP/rotation interaction during this morning's cert rollout in eu-west. Mitigations: we removed the flaky host, increased handshake timeouts, and enabled retries. Asking them to test and provide a few failing request-ids if they see more.

nora: Longer term action items: 1) add preflight OCSP checks post-rotation to verify stapling across all hosts 2) hold DNS TTL high during cert rollouts or use staged weight-based shifts not TTL-only 3) add more granular observability on OCSP latency in Console.

diego: Agree. I'll open a runtime ticket to add OCSP stapling latency to the per-host health checks and add a preflight certificate consistency check before completing rotations.

olivia: Customer replied: after the changes they're seeing a big reduction in errors but noted 1-2 residual timeouts in the last 30m. They're okay with follow-up, asked for ETA on permanent fix.

kevin: I'll coordinate with cert-rollouts and eng-runtime, target fix for within 72 hours: add preflight and a rollback gate.

ashley: Noted — documenting KB steps for support: how to quickly identify rotation-related 5xx: check infra-bot deploy events, host rotation status, OCSP latency in traces, and look for `certificate_reload_error` on hosts.

olivia: Thanks team. I'll update the customer and close the loop once diego confirms runtime changes. :thumbsup:
